import hashlib, json

d = json.load(open("sbom.spdx.json"))

# 1. fix invalid SPDX ID (underscores not allowed)
d["packages"][0]["SPDXID"] = "SPDXRef-Package-demo-pkg"
for r in d["relationships"]:
    if r["relatedSpdxElement"] == "SPDXRef-Package-demo_pkg":
        r["relatedSpdxElement"] = "SPDXRef-Package-demo-pkg"

# 2. verification code is required when filesAnalyzed=true:
#    SHA1 of sorted file checksums, excluding NOASSERTION/NOVALUE entries
sha1s = sorted(
    c["checksumValue"]
    for f in d["files"]
    for c in f["checksums"] if c["algorithm"] == "SHA1"
)
code = hashlib.sha1("\n".join(sha1s).encode()).hexdigest()
d["packages"][0]["verificationCode"] = {
    "packageVerificationCodeValue": code,
    "packageVerificationCodeExcludedFiles": [],
}

# 3. MIT is on the SPDX License List, so it must not sit in
#    hasExtractedLicensingInfos; keep the full text reference instead
d.pop("hasExtractedLicensingInfos", None)

# 4. regenerate evidence/license checksums after metadata.json change
import datetime
def checksums(path):
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    return [{"algorithm": "SHA1", "checksumValue": hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()},
            {"algorithm": "SHA256", "checksumValue": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}]

for f in d["files"]:
    fname = f["fileName"].lstrip("./")
    cs = checksums(fname)
    f["checksums"] = cs
    f["evidence"]["packageFileEvidence"][0]["fileChecksums"] = cs

# rebuild verification code again (checksums changed above)
sha1s = sorted(c["checksumValue"] for f in d["files"] for c in f["checksums"] if c["algorithm"] == "SHA1")
d["packages"][0]["verificationCode"]["packageVerificationCodeValue"] = hashlib.sha1("\n".join(sha1s).encode()).hexdigest()

# refresh creation timestamp
d["creationInfo"]["created"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

json.dump(d, open("sbom.spdx.json", "w"), indent=2)
print("fixed:", d["packages"][0]["SPDXID"], "| verification code:", code[:16] + "... (recomputed again after refresh)")
EOF
